physicalNotes: Radius 0.47015872 Jupiter radii from Mancini et al. 2026 (2026A&A...712A.147M), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...712A.147M/abstract): 33,612.6 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius.
